content: TRAP2 section-to-section variability: TdTomato signal varies across sections due to antibody penetration depth, cutting thickness variation, photobleaching from prior imaging sessions, and background autofluorescence at 568nm. c-Fos threshold sensitivity is well-documented — smallest thresholds (strictest) suppress group differences (false negatives), largest thresholds include nonspecific label (false positives). Recommended approach: use background-relative thresholds rather than fixed intensity cutoffs to accommodate inter-section variability. Parameters tuned on one reference section may not transfer directly to sections with different tissue quality.
